name: Chroma
description: Chroma is the open-source search and retrieval database for AI applications.
composeYaml:
services:
  chromadb:
    image: 'chromadb/chroma:1.0.15'
    volumes:
      - 'chroma-data:/data'
    environment:
      - IS_PERSISTENT=TRUE
      - PERSIST_DIRECTORY=/data
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - /bin/bash
        - '-c'
        - 'cat < /dev/null > /dev/tcp/localhost/8000'
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
